home.tagline: Track the household's money in one place.

accounts.title: Create and manage accounts
accounts.description: Set up an account for every bank, cash box, or card, and keep them organized.

entries.title: Add entries as a transaction or a balance adjustment
entries.description: Log money moving in or out, or set an account's balance directly.

categorization.title: Manage entries with categories and tags
categorization.description: Sort entries into categories and label them with tags to see where money goes.

categoryTree.title: Manage the category tree
categoryTree.description: Organize categories into a nested tree that matches how your family thinks about spending.

reports.title: See totals by category or tag
reports.description: Pick a category or a tag and get a report of the matching entries and their sum, per currency.
